description: Composite figure group of two unlabelled images of different kinds. The top image is a table with five columns — "No of Pass", "Equivalent strain, ε", "Avg. Crystallite size (nm)", "Avg. Microstrain (e2)1/2", "Dislocation density (m-2)" — and four rows: 0 Pass (ε = 0, 61 nm, 3.66 × 10-3, 0.79 × 1015), 1 Pass (0.46, 13.4 nm, 5.18 × 10-3, 5.57 × 1015), 3 Pass (1.4, 10.87 nm, 6.13 × 10-3, 7.5 × 1015) and 5 Pass (2.3, 10.12 nm, 6.88 × 10-3, 8.98 × 1015). The bottom image is an XY plot with "Equivalent plastic strain" (0.0-2.5) on x and "Dislocation density (m-2)" (0.0E+00 to 1.2E+16) on y; black squares are labelled "Measured" and a red dashed line "Predicted using Eq. (7)". An inset fit box prints ρ = 7.96E14 + k1*(1-exp(-k2*x)), k1 = 7.90516E15 ± 5.28171E14, k2 = 1.81319 ± 0.42469, R-Square (COD) = 0.98554. Together they show that MAF straining to ε = 2.3 multiplies dislocation density ~11× and refines crystallites from 61 to ~10 nm, the density following a saturating exponential relation with excellent fit quality.

Scatter-plus-fit plot of dislocation density (m-2, y axis 0.0E+00-1.2E+16) versus equivalent plastic strain (x axis 0.0-2.5). Four black square measured points at strains matching 0, 0.46, 1.4 and 2.3 lie close to a red dashed saturation curve; legend entries 'Measured' and 'Predicted using Eq. (7)'; inset box gives the fit equation and constants k1, k2 and R-Square (COD) = 0.98554.

observations.observation: The table contains four rows for the conditions 0 Pass, 1 Pass, 3 Pass and 5 Pass with equivalent strain values 0, 0.46, 1.4 and 2.3 respectively.
Average crystallite size drops from 61 nm at 0 Pass to 13.4 nm at 1 Pass, 10.87 nm at 3 Pass and 10.12 nm at 5 Pass.
Average microstrain (e2)1/2 rises monotonically from 3.66 × 10-3 (0 Pass) to 5.18 × 10-3 (1 Pass), 6.13 × 10-3 (3 Pass) and 6.88 × 10-3 (5 Pass).
Dislocation density rises from 0.79 × 1015 m-2 (0 Pass) to 5.57 × 1015, 7.5 × 1015 and 8.98 × 1015 m-2 for 1, 3 and 5 Pass.

The plot's y axis is 'Dislocation density (m-2)' spanning 0.0E+00 to 1.2E+16 with labelled ticks every 2.0E+15; the x axis is 'Equivalent plastic strain' spanning 0.0 to 2.5 with ticks at 0.5 intervals.
The legend identifies the black squares as 'Measured' and the red dashed line as 'Predicted using Eq. (7)'.
The inset fit box prints the relation ρ = 7.96E14 + k1*(1-exp(-k2*x)).
The fitted parameters printed in the inset box are k1 = 7.90516E15 ± 5.28171E14 and k2 = 1.81319 ± 0.42469, with R-Square (COD) = 0.98554.
The measured points follow the saturation curve, with the last point at strain ≈2.3 approaching a plateau just below 9.0E+15 m-2; no point lies above 1.0E+16 m-2.
The caption states the crystallite size, microstrain and dislocation density values are calculated from XRD data.
The caption titles this figure 'Effect of equivalent plastic strain on dislocation density.'

The citing text states the fit was obtained from experimental dislocation density versus imposed equivalent strain data (Table 1, Fig. 6) and finds k1 = 7.9 × 1015 m-2 and k2 = 1.813, with ρ0 taken as the dislocation density of MAF-0.
